data.name: ComponentIO
data.description: Model representing input/output specification for a component.

data.name: Component
data.description: Model representing a software component in the architecture.

data.name: Edge
data.description: Model representing a runtime edge between components.

data.name: ExternalActor
data.description: Model representing an external system or service.

data.name: Module
data.description: Model representing a module in the repository blueprint.

data.name: DiagramSpec
data.description: Complete specification for a system architecture diagram.

data.name: ZonePlan
data.description: Model representing a zone plan within a module.

data.name: ModulePlan
data.description: Model representing a module plan in the repository blueprint.

data.name: RepoBlueprint
data.description: Complete blueprint of repository structure with modules and zones.

data.name: TracerRequest
data.description: Request model for tracing operations containing repository blueprint.

modules.name: profiler_agent
modules.description: Agent that analyzes repository structure and generates module blueprints.
modules.purpose: Analyzes repository structure to detect modules, components, and build a blueprint.

data.name: ProfileRequest
data.description: Request model for profiling operations.

data.name: DirGroup
data.description: Model representing a directory group in repository structure.

data.name: ModuleSkeleton
data.description: Model representing the skeleton structure of a module.

data.name: RepoSkeleton
data.description: Model representing the overall skeleton structure of a repository.

business.name: BlueprintValidator
business.description: Validates raw blueprint data against repository skeleton and produces a RepoBlueprint.

business.name: FileTreeService
business.description: Service for traversing and analyzing file tree structures.

business.name: ModuleDetector
business.description: Detects module boundaries from file paths using entry and package markers.

business.name: ProfilerService
business.description: Orchestrates profiling of repository structure using tools and validators.

business.name: RepoMapService
business.description: Builds repository skeleton by detecting modules and organizing directory structure.

tools.name: GetFileTreeTool
tools.description: Tool for retrieving file tree information from the repository.

tools.name: GetManifestFilesTool
tools.description: Tool for retrieving manifest files from the repository.

modules.name: render_agent
modules.description: Agent that renders architecture diagrams in Mermaid format.
modules.purpose: Converts diagram specifications into Mermaid format for visualization.

data.name: RenderRequest
data.description: Request model for rendering diagram specifications.

data.name: RenderResponse
data.description: Response model for rendering operations containing diagram specification.

business.name: EdgeRenderer
business.description: Renders edges in a diagram specification to Mermaid syntax.

business.name: MermaidService
business.description: Orchestrates rendering of diagram specifications to Mermaid format.

business.name: ModuleRenderer
business.description: Renders modules and external actors in a diagram specification to Mermaid syntax.

modules.name: tracer_agent
modules.description: Agent that traces code dependencies and builds call graphs for architecture analysis.
modules.purpose: Traces runtime architecture by analyzing call graphs, building evidence, and validating component relationships.

data.name: TracerResponse
data.description: Response model for tracing operations containing diagram specification.

business.name: AstService
business.description: Parses Python files and extracts signatures and import graphs using AST analysis.

business.name: CallGraphService
business.description: Builds call graph from entry files and temporary directory.

business.name: CorrectionPromptBuilder
business.description: Builds correction prompts based on validation results for iterative refinement.

business.name: EvidenceService
business.description: Builds evidence bundle from file paths, call graph, and AST analysis.

business.name: FileFetchService
business.description: Service for fetching file contents from the repository.

business.name: ValidationResult
business.description: Result model containing validation outcome with components and modules.

business.name: GraphValidator
business.description: Validates diagram specification against evidence bundle and produces validation result.

business.name: SpecAssembler
business.description: Assembles diagram specification from blueprint, raw data, and architecture type.

business.name: TracerService
business.description: Orchestrates tracing of architecture by building call graphs, evidence, and validating specifications.

tools.name: BuildCallGraphTool
tools.description: Tool for building call graphs from source code.

tools.name: BuildEvidenceTool
tools.description: Tool for building evidence bundles from source code analysis.

tools.name: FetchLayerFilesTool
tools.description: Tool for fetching files from specific layers of the repository.

tools.name: ParseAstTool
tools.description: Tool for parsing Python AST from source files.
